summary: Fremont NF camp in Lake County, OR; a lookout was employed there in 1924 and it lay on 1917 telephone and 1922 road routes. No tower or fate recorded.

facts.status_note: No source gives a current status for the camp.

events.note: Planned telephone line from the supervisor's office in Lakeview to Bald Mountain, passing Currier Camp (Lake County Examiner, Sept 13, 1917, as quoted in the forest history).
Trunk road finished to Long Creek and north to Currier Camp in the 1922 season.
Forest Service employed a lookout at Camp Currier, per Silver Lake Leader item of September 4, 1924.

notes_for_editor: The only lookout evidence is a 1924 newspaper item; no tower design or fate is described. The Bach history places Currier Camp on the 1917 telephone route, the 1922 trunk road and among base camps, and does not describe a tower. Currier Guard Station (FS rental, built 1933, Paisley RD) shares the name and district but is not shown to be the same site, so it is cited only as a separate place. The Fremont Point page on the same site places a 1931 tower about ten miles from Currier Camp; not used.
